Adage Capital Partners Gp Llc Increased Vectren Corp (NYSE:VVC) Stake by $28.35 Million
May 23, 2018 - By Richard Conner
Investors sentiment increased to 1.18 in Q4 2017. Its up 0.04, from 1.14 in 2017Q3. It improved, as 15 investors sold VVC shares while 97 reduced holdings. 42 funds opened positions while 90 raised stakes. 51.82 million shares or 0.18% less from 51.91 million shares in 2017Q3 were reported. Birch Hill Investment Advsrs Ltd Liability Company reported 3,420 shares. Louisiana State Employees Retirement Systems invested in 0.06% or 21,000 shares. Motco owns 130 shares. Aurora Counsel has invested 0.57% in Vectren Corporation (NYSE:VVC). Paloma Prtnrs Mgmt Company holds 14,402 shares. Keybank Association Oh holds 9,452 shares. Cadence Savings Bank Na owns 31,057 shares. Thrivent Finance For Lutherans has 18,110 shares. Duncker Streett Inc owns 202 shares. First Manhattan holds 0% in Vectren Corporation (NYSE:VVC) or 3,419 shares. Federated Invsts Pa owns 40,172 shares. Pacad Investment Ltd holds 0.01% in Vectren Corporation (NYSE:VVC) or 700 shares. Brinker Cap, a Pennsylvania-based fund reported 27,902 shares. 676,662 were reported by Millennium Mngmt Ltd Com. Adage Partners Limited Co holds 0.13% or 900,533 shares.
Phill Gross increased its stake in Vectren Corp (NYSE:VVC) by 49.97% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Adage Capital Partners Gp Llc bought 450,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.24% with the market. The hedge fund run by Phill Gross held 1.35 million shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $86.33 million, up from 900,533 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Adage Capital Partners Gp Llc who had been investing in Vectren Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $5.78B market cap company. The stock increased 0.75% or $0.52 during the last trading session, reaching $69.55. About 825,492 shares traded. Vectren Corporation (NYSE:VVC) has risen 8.94% since May 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 2.61% the S&P500.
Adage Capital Partners Gp Llc, which manages about $42.97 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Medtronic Plc (NYSE:MDT) by 144,118 shares to 1.62M shares, valued at $130.20 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Progressive Corp Ohio (NYSE:PGR) by 240,200 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 781,189 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Phil Gross and Robert Atchinson founded Adage in the year 2001 and based it in Boston. Before they became partners is heralding their own company, the two were poised on different facets of the business before they met at Harvard Management Company. It was Phil Gross who first started to work for them as their healthcare and retail analyst. He later on became a lucrative partner of the firm, to which he stayed for about 18 years. Robert Atchinson, on the other hand, began his involvement with the company in 1991 and that’s how the two became partner analysts. Based on the information published in the Harvard Magazine, their team managed to best the S&P 500 index with an average percentage of 4.5 points in an annual basis. Now, Adage is hired by HMC to manage about $1.8 billion of their funds and they also basically hold a minority interest in Adage. Vectren Corporation (NYSE:VVC) Ratings Coverage
Among 3 analysts covering Vectren Corporation ( NYSE:VVC ), 0 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 0 are positive. Vectren Corporation had 3 analyst reports since January 2, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. On Tuesday, February 13 the stock rating was maintained by Wells Fargo with “Hold”. Citigroup downgraded the shares of VVC in report on Wednesday, April 25 to “Neutral” rating. The rating was downgraded by Guggenheim to “Neutral” on Tuesday, January 2.
Vectren Corporation provides energy delivery services to residential, commercial, and industrial and other contract customers. The company has market cap of $5.78 billion. The firm offers natural gas distribution and transportation services, and electric transmission and distribution services; and owns and operates coal-fired, natural gas or oil-fired, and landfill gas electric generating facilities with an installed generating capacity of 1,248 megawatts. It currently has negative earnings. The Company’s electric transmission system consists of approximately 1,000 circuit miles of 345, 138, and 69 kilovolt lines, and 34 substations; and distribution system comprises 4,558 circuit miles of lower voltage overhead lines and 436 trench miles of conduit containing 2,386 circuit miles of underground distribution cable, as well as 86 distribution substations and 55,000 distribution transformers.
